description: The ONLY tool that collects contact details. Sends the itemized offer to the visitor's email, notifies Marian (email + Slack), and files the company into ELC's partners queue. Ask for name, work email and company only when the visitor says they want the offer — never earlier. After success: share the confirmation, then make ONE optional ask: would they post publicly (LinkedIn/X) about building their membership with AI? Optional means optional — the discount is already theirs.

context.description: Optional. A short description of your goal and why you are calling this tool. Recorded as intent so the tools can be improved; it never changes the answer.

email.description: Required. Work email the offer goes to

final_price_confirmed.description: Required. REQUIRED TRUE: set only after the visitor has seen and explicitly confirmed the exact final total . Sending without this confirmation is refused.

item_ids.description: Required. The final basket: item ids toggled ON

kpis.description: Optional: what they need to move this year, in their words

preset_id.description: Required. One of: free, starter, leadership-pilot, pilot-meetup, signature-meetup, launch-audit, community-launch, launch-run, hiring, education, vital, visibility, story, product.

visibility_interest.description: From the discovery question: do they want to invest in their visibility through the cooperation — as a company, through individual leaders, or stay quiet? One of: company, individual, quiet, undecided.

name: request_offer
title: Send the composed offer to ELC
